newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Clinton to stop in London to see Blair late in May.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to stop in London to see Blair late in May.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton will stop in London to visit new British Prime Minister Tony Blair in connection with his May 28 trip to the Netherlands, the White House announced on Friday.
Spokesman Mike McCurry said Clinton "has accepted an invitation to stop in London to meet with newly elected British Prime Minister Tony Blair."
He said the schedule for the visit and meeting had yet to be completed. It will be Clinton's first meeting with Blair since Blair took office.

Clinton is to visit the Netherlands on May 28 to attend a U.S.-European summit and the commemoration of the 50th anniversary of the Marshall Plan that helped rebuild Europe after the Second World War.
Aides said it was not clear yet whether Clinton would stop in London on his way to the Netherlands or on the way back.
